entries.german:
1279. 0. T. Rosenberch. — Derselbe wiederholt die Schenkung der Rosenberger Kirche und fügt die Filialkirche zu Ober-Haid hinzu.

Bone rei datur consilium, ut presentis uite conferatur sub- sidium, vbi eterne remunerationis premium exspectatur. Sciant igitur presentes ac posteri, quod ego Heinricus de Rosenberch pre- ceptis diuinis et salutaribus informatus domui sanete Marie virginis in Hohenfurt, quam pater meus pie memorie dominus Wokko multa beniuolentia cepit construere et fundare, ecclesiam in Rosenberch cum filia in Mendia cum tercia parte decimarum et ¡us patronatus liberaliter omni iure tradidi perpetuo possidendam, ita tamen ut abbas et conuentus Jacobum sacerdotem nostrum capellanum diebus vite sue non priuent suo iure, vt fratres ibidem domino iugiter ser uientes et pro salute mea atque progenitorum et successorum meorum fideles ad dominum intercessores non alicuius necessitatis occasio aut desides faciat, aut robur sanete conuersationis quod absit, infrin gat, quia plurimis indigent, qui indigentias plurimorum conantur f¡deliter releuare. Vt autem bec rata permaneant et nulla queant in posterum calumpnia perturban, presentem cartam ipsis tradidi mei sigilli munimine roboratam cum testibus subnotatis, qui sunt: Domi- nus Andreas miles, Leupoldus, dominus Benata miles, Onscho ipsius frater, Nycolaus, Vlricus de Weischel et eius frater Bseborius, Troyanus suisque fratribus, et alii quam plures. entries.english: Heinrich von Rosenberg, instructed by divine and salutary teachings, gives to the house of Saint Mary the Virgin at Hohenfurt the church at Rosenberg, together with its daughter church at Mendia, a third part of the tithes, and the right of patronage, to possess perpetually with all rights. His father, Lord Woko of blessed memory, had begun and founded the house with great generosity. However, the abbot and convent are not to deprive their chaplain, the priest Jacob, of his rights during his lifetime. Heinrich makes the grant so that the brothers serving the Lord there may faithfully intercede with God for the salvation of Heinrich, his ancestors, and successors, and so that no need or neglect weaken the strength of their holy life. He gave them this charter, confirmed by his seal, to keep the grant firm and free from future challenge. Witnesses: Lord Andreas, knight; Leupoldus; Lord Benata, knight, and his brother Onscho; Nycolaus; Ulrich von Weischel and his brother Bseborius; Troyanus and his brothers; and many others. Enacted at Rosenberg in 1279. The damaged seal hangs from a parchment strip and is like that described in no. XXII. Reference: Millauer, p. 79, no. 14.
